camel_example: aliyun vs CreateRenderingProject --region cn-hangzhou --ProjectName du_merchant_d --version 2018-12-12 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a cloud application service project and configures session-related properties
description_zh: 创建一个新的云应用服务项目，并设置会话等相关属性
name: CreateRenderingProject

parameters.help_en:
The custom project name, which serves as the unique identifier for the project.
Naming conventions:
The length must be 1 to 128 characters.
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).
The first and last characters must be letters or digits
parameters.help_zh:
自定义项目名，将作为项目的唯一标记。
默认取值规范：
长度1-128
小写字母、数字、下划线'_'、中划线'-'、点分段'.'
首、尾字符必须为字母或数字
parameters.name: project_name

fields.help_en:
The mode in which the session starts the cloud application service. Valid values:
Async: asynchronous mode.
Sync: synchronous mode
fields.help_zh:
会话启动云应用服务的模式，取值范围，
Async：异步
Sync：同步
fields.name: start_mode

parameters.help_en: The description of the project. The description must be 0 to 255 characters in length
parameters.name: description

ProjectId.description_en: The project ID. You can call the ListRenderingProjects operation to query the project ID
ProjectId.description_zh: 项目ID。您可以调用ListRenderingProjects查看项目的ID
